name: Neelkanth Limited
about: Neelkanth Limited engages in the trading of agriculture and allied sector activities in India. The company offers rice, wheat, maize, and coarse cereals. It exports its products under the White Pearl brand name. The company was formerly known as R.T. Exports Limited and changed its name to Neelkanth Limited in August 2023. Neelkanth Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.
